The z-average particle size (DLS Z-Ave) and polydispersity index (PDI) results of
the latex particles obtained from DLS experiments are also provided in Table 1.
To test for reversibility in temperature response, the measurements were first
taken at (i) a temperature of about 40°C, then at (ii) a temperature of about 20°C
and finally (iii) at a temperature of about 40°C. As shown in Table 1, the average
particle size recorded at temperature
(iii) for the samples remains relatively
similar to those recorded at temperature (i). Therefore, the temperature response
was proven to be reversible.
